subject: ranger: should replace ast.Or with ast.LogicalOr (#55476)
summary: Fixes ranger’s reconstructed predicate to use logical OR (`ast.LogicOr` / "or") instead of bitwise OR (`ast.Or` / "bitor") when combining `ISNULL(col)` with `EQ/IN` during point-to-expression reconstruction, ensuring planner/ranger treat it as a boolean disjunction; adds regression coverage in ranger tests and a planner issue test for ISNULL+IN under GROUP BY/HAVING.
